title: Annotatio I §.III open: Reformed prove Hoc est corpus meum improper — GENERICA and SPECIFICA genera
pass_a_gloss: §. III. For the rest, that the definitive propositions of the Sacred Supper just named — and especially this one commonly disputed, This is my body — are not proper but improper, the Reformed prove by arguments to be reduced to two genera, of which the prior concerns the GENERIC, the posterior the SPECIFIC nature of the proposition taken materially.
pass_b_english: §. III. The Reformed argue that the definitive Supper propositions — above all This is my body — are not proper but improper.
They reduce the proofs to two genera: the GENERIC and the SPECIFIC nature of the proposition taken materially.
source_text:
§. III.
Ceterum propositiones S. Coenae modò dictas definitivas, & sigillatim hanc (de qua communiter disputari solet) Hoc est corpus meum, non propriam, sed impropriam esse, probant Reformati argumentis ad duo genera revocandis, quorum prius GENERICAM, posterius SPECIFICAM propositionis, materialiter acceptae, naturam concernit.
